contract: Each profile injects at least 1000 faults. Observer failures are zero.
A fenced leader epoch and a conflicting marker or stale offset generation leave the committed set unchanged.
Repeating a marker or high-watermark advance does not duplicate the committed outcome.
Reopen preserves committed ids. A follower does not observe leader appends that were not replicated.
limits: Filesystem sync errors were not injected. The journal file descriptor stays writable after open.
The partition step is two local logs, not a multi-host network partition.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
